QF.id: XVI Clearing, Settlement and Risk Management_68

question.text: In the commodity delivery process, who transfers the warehouse receipt to the clearing corporation?

answer.text: The selling-side clearing member on behalf of the seller

explanation.text: The Logic: In commodity pay-in, the selling-side clearing member transfers the warehouse receipt to the clearing corporation. On the pay-out side, the clearing corporation transfers ownership to the buyer's name and clearing member A then transfers the receipt to client X. The Trap: The buyer, the warehouse operator, or SEBI do not initiate this receipt transfer to the clearing corporation — the obligation sits with the selling-side clearing member. Note: The flow runs as selling TM Q to clearing member B to CC for warehouse-receipt pay-in, then CC to clearing member A to client X for the commodity pay-out; the buying TM (P) transfers funds, not the receipt.
